claims.assertion: Mari says Etorthans were scheduled to arrive in two stages to supervise and audit the Solar System’s Federation region.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: Mari says the Federation includes thousands of civilizations, mostly benevolent, and that she does not expect hostilities over the audit.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: Mari says repeated internet outages affected Toleka and Urmah links at Viera; she suspects some local officials may be deliberately obstructing them.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She says outages do not mean war is expected.

review_flags: Claims about arrival schedules, outages, and motives are attributed to Mari Swaruu.
coverage_gaps: Other comments on rumors and alleged events
